candidates.reason: Deferred (not added): MNRE Office Memorandum F.No.32/645/2017-SPV dated 28 Mar 2026 (on pmkusum.mnre.gov.in) says the PM-KUSUM scheme timeline ended 31.03.2026; committed liabilities will be subsumed into PM KUSUM 2.0, which is 'in the proposal stage'; the extension to 31.03.2027 covers only projects with PPAs/NTPs issued on or before 31.12.2025. candidates.name: PM-JANMAN (Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan)
candidates.reason: Verified add: current (Lok Sabha unstarred Q1879 and Q2031 answered 30.07.2026 report ongoing progress to 30.06.2026; PIB Feb/Mar 2026). Clear household benefit: pucca house under PMAY-G (Rs 2 lakh; Rs 2.39 lakh with convergence) for PVTG households in kaccha houses, plus electricity/water/LPG/health/education convergence. Eligibility: PVTG households in the 18 states + A&N Islands identified via PM Gati Shakti habitation survey; exclusion only if already has pucca house or a government-employee member (PIB Feb 2026). Added as in-pm-janman with verify:true.
candidates.notes: Official mission period 2023-24 to 2025-26 (PIB); extension to March 2027 reported only in press — kept verify:true. | verified_add means human approved adding via PR — this script does not mutate schemes.json

candidates.name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
candidates.reason: Out of scope: infrastructure, not an individual entitlement. Jal Jeevan Mission funds village/State piped-water supply schemes (Functional Household Tap Connections) implemented by State water departments and Gram Panchayat committees; there is no individual application, eligibility test or benefit a person can claim.

candidates.name: PM SHRI (PM Schools for Rising India)
candidates.reason: Out of scope: infrastructure, not an individual entitlement. PM SHRI upgrades selected existing government schools (institutional selection via challenge mode, funds to schools/UTs); students get no individual scheme benefit to apply for.

candidates.name: PM e-Bus Sewa
candidates.reason: Out of scope: infrastructure, not an individual entitlement. PM e-Bus Sewa funds e-bus deployment and depot/charging infrastructure for cities on a PPP (gross cost contract) basis; no individual beneficiary or application.

candidates.name: SVAMITVA (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas)
candidates.reason: Deferred (not added, not rejected): SVAMITVA gives rural abadi households a property card / Record of Rights usable for bank loans (a genuine household benefit), but it is delivered by a village-wide drone survey by Survey of India with States distributing cards — there is no individual application, eligibility test or claim route on svamitva.nic.in / MoPR. Lok Sabha Q2553 (04.08.2026): 3.30 of 3.38 lakh notified villages surveyed; 3.24 crore cards prepared, 2.72 crore distributed; survey phase is close to complete. Revisit only if MoPR or a State publishes a household request/claim route for cards.

title.value: Minister Valdez launches call for proposals for the Women Entrepreneurship Strategy Ecosystem Fund

summary.value: Building the strongest economy in the G7 requires the full and equal participation of women. Through the Women Entrepreneurship Strategy (WES), the federal government is helping more women entrepreneurs access the financing, training and networks they need to succeed as we build a stronger, more competitive Canada.
